description: Header file defining classes and functions for dynamic HLSL shader generation in Direct3D renderer of ANGLE project.

classes.name: DecorateVariable
classes.description: Represents a variable decoration for HLSL code, non-copyable.

classes.name: PixelShaderOutputVariable
classes.description: Stores information about a pixel shader output variable.

classes.name: BuiltinVarying
classes.description: Represents a built-in varying variable with semantic and index.

classes.name: BuiltinInfo
classes.description: Holds built-in varying variables for different shader stages.

classes.name: BuiltinVaryingsD3D
classes.description: Manages built-in varyings for D3D shaders based on metadata and packing.

classes.name: DynamicHLSL
classes.description: Main class for generating HLSL shaders dynamically for Direct3D in ANGLE.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the name of a DecorateVariable, adding an underscore if it doesn't start with 'gl_'.

methods.name: GetVaryingSemantic
methods.description: Returns the semantic string for varyings based on shader model and point size usage.

methods.name: generateVertexShaderForInputLayout
methods.description: Generates a vertex shader string for a given input layout and shader attributes.

methods.name: generatePixelShaderForOutputSignature
methods.description: Generates a pixel shader string for a specified output signature.

methods.name: generateComputeShaderForImage2DBindSignature
methods.description: Generates a compute shader for image2D binding.

methods.name: generateShaderLinkHLSL
methods.description: Links multiple shader stages into a complete HLSL shader.

methods.name: generateGeometryShaderPreamble
methods.description: Creates a preamble string for geometry shaders.

methods.name: getPixelShaderOutputKey
methods.description: Retrieves the output key for pixel shaders based on current state and program.

methods.name: GenerateAttributeConversionHLSL
methods.description: Generates HLSL code for attribute conversion based on format.
